items.title: John Levy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I know it was the Downbeat in Chicago. Joe Sh – what was his name? I’m trying to think of the name of the guy who owned that club.

ctx.x: Where in Philadelphia? Where in Washington?

At the top jazz clubs. I don’t remember the names of all of the different clubs for that particular time. I know it was the Downbeat in Chicago. Joe Sh – what was his name? I’m trying to think of the name of the guy who owned that club. Then we’d come across, play a date in St. Louis. There’s a club there. Then we’d play Kansas City. Then we’d end up in Denver. If we took the northern route, there was one group of clubs. Or we took the southern route. Then we come into Los Angeles first, coming from, say, we’d do…
So you played in L.A. along Central Avenue?
